title: Watashi no Machi no Chiba-kun ha

overview: A garden tenant wants to create a biodiversity project with wild flowers. It's nothing at all for the allotment association's older residents, but the young people are excited.
title: Balladen om kolonihaven

overview: I teach 'Jaeyeon', a stuntman who quietly sticks to his principles, and 'Doha', an idol who was cast in an action movie, but he is arbitrarily proud and does not listen. However, Jae-yeon, who is just as stubborn, and Do-ha, who uses tricks, are trained without much effort, and the two eventually become enemies. Then one day, the two bickering as usual was filmed on idol content, and Jaeyeon gains mysterious popularity... and an unexpected situation begins!
title: Match Play

overview: In Vital Signs heroine Emmy Correll is in a rut. She wishes her dull, disappointing life was more like her favorite medical drama Vital Signs – where the characters are life-saving heroes with endlessly exciting love lives. But when Emmy's wish comes true, and she is transported INTO the show, she must confront whether this new life is what she truly wants. Waking up in a TV show is disorienting! Especially because in this world, Emmy is apparently a newly hired doctor. But once she gets over the shock, she realizes she's seen every episode; and she knows what's going to happen. And that means here, in this world, she's kind of a genius.
title: Vital Signs

overview: Melbourne International Comedy Festival's Deadly Funny.
title: Deadly Funny

overview: A prophecy foretold that victory goes to the one who has the priestess' blessing. Yang Xue Wu, the last priestess of her clan, unwittingly embroiled in a war between Northern Qi and Northern Zhou. Although she foresees a tragic fate for Lan Ling Wang, the military general of Northern Qi, she nonetheless falls in love with him and helps him win the war against Yuwen Yong, the Emperor of Northern Zhou. However, her action only brings him closer to his fate. As his standing among his people grows, so does the murderous jealousy in Crown prince's heart. Can she protect him when it's family who wants him dead?
title: Prince of Lan Ling

overview: Caught in a prison riot, a human rights lawyer poses as an inmate to survive. As he blends in, chaos and personal loss unveil the darkness within him.
title: Celda 211

overview: When a wealthy heir is accused of raping a classmate, a brutal battle erupts between two families-one fighting for justice, the other wielding power, money, and fear to bury the truth. As the war escalates, and secrets unravel, both sets of parents are forced to confront the terrifying lengths they'll go to protect their children-and the haunting realization that morality is never black and white.
title: El Juicio

overview: A psychological thriller set in a conservative Christian sect about a dutiful wife who is set on a dangerous path of emancipation and sexual awakening when she encounters an escaped convict.
title: Unchosen

overview: Drag Race France is back with a brand-new season: Drag Race France All Stars. For the first time in the history of the French show, 10 iconic queens return to the stage to claim the ultimate title of Super Queen of French Drag and win 30,000 euros.
title: Drag Race France All Stars

overview: Juana is a charming young woman who accidentally becomes pregnant. Gabriel Rubio, a man with whom she has nothing in common, but both are predestined to meet. Discover this story full of love, passion, revenge.
title: La Historia de Juana

overview: Comedy that explores the contradictions of love through two couples who fall in love, but their fear of commitment prevents them from risking losing their independence.
title: ¿A Qué Estás Esperando?

overview: Guys from different fields join forces in search of the villains to return the money they invested in their fraudulent structure. The guys find a new office of the criminals and open a cafe nearby undercover to conduct surveillance and bring them to justice.
title: Pistirmadagi Osh

overview: Highway Patrol takes a rare fly-on-the-wall glimpse into the working lives of the Australian police officers who spend their days striving to keep our roads safe. From high-speed chases to violent conflicts and catching speeding drivers to investigating crash scenes, officers of the Victoria Police Traffic Units spend each day on the front line. As part of their job, the officers featured in Highway Patrol deal with drunken hooligans, defiant law breakers and simply lazy motorists, and they all pose an equal danger to themselves and others. These officers are passionate about their work, proud of what they do on a daily basis and invite viewers into their remarkable world in Highway Patrol.
title: Highway Patrol

overview: Dulce María is like her name, a sweet 5-year-old girl, full of joy and good feelings. With the death of her mother, her father, Luciano Larios, sinks into depression and pain, and decides to distance himself from everything and everyone.
title: Carita de Ángel

overview: A comedic TV series that follows the journey of the newly formed boy band, IceGuys, as they strive for stardom. Led by real-life Icelandic celebrities Aron Can, Friðrik Dór, Herra Hnetusmjör, Jón Jónsson, and Rúrik Gíslason
title: IceGuys

overview: After being raped, chambermaid Amelie develops superpowers that allow her to identify and fight sex offenders. She suppresses her own trauma and judges good and evil - until she meets her own rapist.
title: Angemessen Angry

overview: Pathomkan is serving 1 year and 6 months sentence for a check fraud law. In prison, he meets Bible, a young man who seems indifferent to life yet possesses a magnetic pull that draws Pathomkan in. Bible is the reason Pathomkan can smile. He is the person Pathomkan wants to wake up to every morning. He fills Pathomkan‘s time in prison with countless memories. And he is the person that making it impossible for Pathomkan to forget their bond. This is the story of people's love of the unloved, but they yearn for affection and being loved in the prison filled with strangers.
title: Winter Is Not the Death of Summer, But the Birth of Spring

overview: Aerial Australia takes viewers on a breathtaking airborne odyssey across this diverse continent unveiling a tapestry of awe-inspiring landscapes that exist alongside the rich heritage of one of the oldest living cultures on Earth.
title: Aerial Australia

overview: Highlights of the Yachting Sail GP competition.
title: Yachting Sail GP Highlights

overview: Because of her father's medical expenses, Lin Mian is desperate and almost goes astray. Fortunately, she is saved by the kind-hearted doctor Shi Lin. Shi Lin is attracted by her weakness and strength, and builds a fortress of love for her to resist the darkness. Under Shi Lin's protection, Lin Mian transforms and grows, and the two welcome the light together.
title: Addicted Only to You

overview: Félix Séguin and Victoria Charlton invite experts from the criminal world to confess. Investigations, disappearances, encounters with the underworld and archives that have marked the collective memory will come together in the crime headquarters. Through different segments, the experts tell their stories as varied as they are surprising, which will delight crime lovers.
title: Le Parloir

overview: 《暧昧失温》是一部网络短剧，全剧共78集，围绕主角贺枭与许倾欢之间复杂微妙的情感纠葛展开。贺枭，一位在外界眼中冷峻孤傲的商业精英，实则内心深藏着对真爱的渴望。许倾欢，一个温柔善良、独立自主的女性，她的出现意外地打破了贺枭平静的生活。 两人因一次偶然的机会相遇，随后在工作中频繁交集，逐渐产生了一种超越友情的暧昧情愫。然而，这份感情却如同剧名所示，始终保持着一种微妙的"失温"状态，既不够热烈到足以称为爱情，又难以回归到普通朋友的界限。 剧情中，贺枭与许倾欢在相互试探与靠近中，经历了误会、分离与重逢。随着剧情的深入，两人内心的真实情感逐渐被揭露，他们不得不面对自己内心的渴望与恐惧，以及外界的重重压力。最终，在一系列波折之后，两人能否跨越重重障碍，让这份暧昧失温的感情升温至真爱，成为全剧最大的悬念。 《暧昧失温》以其紧凑的剧情、细腻的情感描绘和深刻的主题探讨，吸引了众多观众的关注与喜爱。
title: 暧昧失温

overview: Ma San, the heir to the Yin-Yang Tailor, wields mystical needlework to save defense attorney Song Yuan from the brink of death. Together, they uncover strange cases, restoring justice to the common people. In the end, they bring a corrupt official and his son to justice.
title: Stitching Life and Death

overview: Multi-award-winning Māori musician and actor Troy Kingi is up to his eighth album in his ambitious 10/10/10 mission, where he aims to record 10 albums in 10 genres in 10 years. However, for the past few years, writer's block has caused Troy's creative river to run dry. In the hopes of sourcing some much-needed inspiration for his upcoming desert-rock album (a first-love genre for him), Troy makes the journey from Kerikeri to Joshua Tree to fulfil a lifelong dream of recording at one of the most iconic music studios in the world, Rancho De La Luna. With the ambitious schedule of writing and recording an entire album in just 10 days, Troy and his band need to dig deep. Luckily for them, the Joshua Tree desert is filled with lots of interesting and eccentric locals who are more than happy to help Troy and the band get inspired. Desert Hīkoi isn't just a music documentary; it's the journey of a group of artists finding their richest vein of creativity, whilst going deep within and learning about themselves.
title: Troy Kingi's Desert Hikoi

overview: Treasure Hunt was a popular UK game show, based on the format of the French show La Chasse au Trésor, created by Jacques Antoine. It appeared on Channel 4 between 28 December 1982 and 18 May 1989 and was revived by BBC Two between 16 December 2002 and 2 August 2003. A team of two contestants, always in the studio, had to use a library of (deliberately relevant) maps and reference materials to solve up to five clues, and communicate instructions via a radio link to a skyrunner who had the use of a helicopter. The contestants were given the first clue for free, the solving of which would lead to the location of the second clue and so on until a trinket or other significant object was found by solving the final clue. The contestants won a higher cash prize each time they solved a clue correctly. This was all done "against the clock". Even once the contestants had solved the final clue, the skyrunner still had to confirm they were correct, by reaching the final target. On a few occasions, the contestants solved all five clues with time to spare, in which case, a bonus clue was given to the contestants. This typically resulted in their winning a bottle of champagne.
title: Treasure Hunt

overview: Piri Weepu swaps his rugby boots for tramping boots as he hunts, fishes, forages and explores the Māori communities of Aotearoa.
title: Piri's Tiki Tour

overview: Pony, along with her college friends Leslie (gay) and Xuan (lesbian), explores the romantic relationships each of them desires. Through interactions with different partners, they gradually understand their own bottom lines and genuine emotional needs. They often gather at Mama's AS Bistro bar to share their relationship frustrations and seek advice from Mama. Despite their different sexual orientations, they sincerely share their longings and frustrations in love, striving to overcome their personalflaws to find relationships that make them feel comfortable. No label, no tag, just love is the key spirit in this show.
title: The Nipple Talk

overview: In the 2020s, JUNG KOOK emerged as a top solo artist. He won over audiences with chart-topping hits like "Seven," "3D," and "Standing Next to You." To this day, he still gives his all to make ARMY proud, and is constantly striving to improve and evolve. Instead of resting on his laurels with his natural talent and impressive career, he continues to blaze his own trail. From his solo career launch single to the promotion of his album GOLDEN, experience eight months of Jung Kook's golden life as he travels the globe, visiting cities like New York, London, and Seoul. This is the story of Jung Kook, an artist who never stops dreaming.
title: JUNG KOOK: I AM STILL > THE ORIGINAL

overview: Highlights from Thanksgiving Day parades in cities across the country will air live, including in New York City, Philadelphia, Chicago, Houston, and Detroit. CNN correspondents will provide on-the-ground reporting from celebrations nationwide.
title: Thanksgiving in America

overview: Nearly 40 years after his summertime reign of terror on the streets of Los Angeles, the myth of the "Night Stalker" still looms large. Now, a series of prison recordings of Richard Ramirez unearths new truths in the Peacock original docuseries Richard Ramirez: The Night Stalker Tapes. Collected from more than 25 hours of audio recordings – most of which have never been heard before – and including revealing interviews with his family, friends and wife, the series explores the dark forces that led Ramirez to become the infamous Night Stalker. Plus, some of the women impacted by Ramirez over the years share their experiences, from former friends to victims' families, and his own niece, who speaks out for the first time in a documentary. The series also goes inside the confounding love story of a former teen magazine editor who fell in love with Ramirez and eventually became his wife.
title: Richard Ramirez: The Night Stalker Tapes

overview: This is the story of Ichikawa Kazuya and Narita Misao during the empty four years when they decided to split and spend their time apart. During the four years, Kazuya couldn't get along with his new girlfriend. He fell into a relationship slump and realised that he couldn't stop thinking about Misao. Misao, on the other hand, devoted herself to her work. Deno Tsukasa is the boss of Kazuya and was appointed as the general manager at a young age. One night, Tsukasa was led by a cat and arrived at a bar. There, he met a mysterious woman called Nao. Tsukasa and Nao were attracted to each other but continued to have a relationship while hiding their real thoughts.
title: Liar: Surechigau Koi

overview: In the Tiansheng Kingdom, Su Fengzhi, the youngest daughter of General Su Lie, faces a family tragedy orchestrated by her scheming brother-in-law. She joins forces with Third Prince Jian Qingxun, another victim of the conspiracy, and together they navigate deadly trials and personal conflicts. United by love and a shared thirst for vengeance, they seek justice and a chance to start anew.
title: Into Your Heart

overview: Every Second Counts was a British game show based on the American game show of the same name. It aired on BBC1 between 8 February 1986 and 29 October 1993 and was hosted by Paul Daniels. Gameplay was almost identical as the American version. Each week, three married couples competed against each other to win seconds of time. In each half of the game, one member of each couple sat in the "driver's seat" and answered questions (which were all statements, each with two possible answers). Each correct answer earned seconds, while an incorrect answer eliminated that player from the round. Correct answers in the first half won two seconds, and correct answers in the second half earned four seconds. Players had a choice of two categories of questions for each round.
title: Every Second Counts
Meeting you at the center of the world

overview: When life gives them only two choices, Truth or Dare, will they tell the truth or take the dare? And if it were you, what would you choose? The story follows the first encounter between two completely different men, Captain Jade and foreign-trained Inspector Kamin. They have to compete and uncover the real killer behind a mysterious death case. The deeper they investigate, the more bodies begin to fall! But amid all the dangers, there is still a touch of romance that makes the heart race.
title: Dare You to Death

overview: Head 2 Head follows the relationship between rivals Jerome and Jin. It began with childhood hatred, and even in college, they stuck together, studying fashion design. They lived opposite each other, shared the same group of friends, and even had close families. Despite their efforts to rekindle their relationship, it never worked. Instead, they developed a simmering hatred that led to them clinging to each other. Ultimately, the heavens seemed to be playing a joke. Jerome had a dream 10 years in the future, and saw that the person he currently hates to death would eventually become his life partner. What started as a simple annoyance, turned into a feeling he never imagined. Two relationships that were destined. No matter how much they hate each other or how much they push each other away, believe me when I say that what you hate will come true. It's true.
title: Head 2 Head

overview: This love triangle begins when Jira gets fired, and now he's suffering from burnout syndrome. To sooth his troubled heart, he visits a bar where he meets Pheem, an IT guy who charms Jira enough for them to exchange contact and stay in touch. Koh Korrawick is the businessman who owns a famous e-commerce platform. Koh is also a mystery, a kind of shut-in, who hates meeting people. He's looking for someone to be his "face" and conduct his business for him. When he meets Jira in a restaurant, Jira's fearless strength imprints a strong impression on him. Meanwhile, for Jira, the mysterious air around Koh captivates him and inspires him to put charcoal to papers again, sketching the outline of Koh's body. That is the first time Jira feels alive making his tedious art. Within the close proximity, Jira is torn between his relationships with Koh and with Pheem. What kind of love does he exactly want?
title: Burnout Syndrome

overview: The Paul Daniels Magic Show was a British magic show presented by Paul Daniels from 1979 to 1994. Daniels' assistant throughout the series was Debbie McGee, whom he married in 1988.
title: The Paul Daniels Magic Show

overview: Sun is a womanizer who breaks women's hearts for a living. This time, he is hired to break Sairung's heart. She is a reporter for an online news agency. Sairung is bright, confident, and sexy. The next day, he meets her again. But her personality has completely changed. She becomes quiet, cold, and unfriendly. Moreover, she doesn't recognize him even though they met yesterday. Sun finds out that her strange behaviors are similar to those who have multiple personality disorders. In total, she has five different personalities. Sairung's father, Thepchai, who secretly hires Sun, stumbles upon an unproven theory: if every personality falls in love with the same person, the identities may reunite into one. Armed with charm, wit, and every trick in the book, Sun takes on the challenge of making each version of Sairung fall for him. Will he succeed?
title: I Love "A Lot Of" You

overview: Wan suddenly loses her job, and to make things worse, her father dies of a heart attack. This forces her to take care of an old grocery store. There, she meets Maewnam, along with a cup of instant noodles labeled with a note: "For a customer at 11 PM." Who would come to buy food at a grocery store at this hour? That customer turns out to be Maewnam and yes, that is because Wan was Maewnam's love at first sight in the past. She starts hitting on Wan again, head over heels in love. The story reaches her friends, Prof. Chompoo and Prof. Tonnam. Whenever Maewnam consults them about Wan, their opinions always go in opposite directions. What should Maewnam do to win Wan's heart?
title: Whale Store xoxo

overview: Senior theater student Jack sets out to create an ambitious stage production, Romeo & Romeo—a bold, male–male reimagining of the classic Romeo & Juliet. What begins as a dream project soon becomes an emotional minefield when Jack casts friends, exes and their admirers. As rehearsals intensify, unresolved feelings, unspoken crushes, desire, jealousy, and rivalry spiral out of control. Caught between art and emotion, six friends find their relationships tested to the limit.
title: Only Friends: Dream On

overview: The stories of that summer… would change him forever. When Lava, a mischievous young man, is sent to stay with Uncle Peng on an island to reform his behavior during the summer, he expects a carefree vacation. But everything changes when he encounters a mysterious young man washed up unconscious on the beach. With no memory of who he is, Lava finds himself responsible for taking care of him, unaware that he is, in fact, a prince.
title: That Summer

overview: Pai and North, the nephews of a billionaire tycoon and heirs to the Jiramongkolthanan empire, fall victim to two scammers, Yu and Tim, who marry them for their fortunes! North secretly ties the knot with Yu, only to discover he's been conned. Worse, he can't get a divorce because he's already signed over part of his assets!! Meanwhile, Tim is busy planning his upcoming wedding with Pai. Will Tim be exposed as a scammer who has been playing Pai all along!? When love begins with lies, where does it lead?
title: My Romance Scammer

overview: Botpleng, a young man who has lost his memory from an accident, has received a mysterious diary telling him that he used to have a lover named Tankhun. Yet, after meeting him, Botpleng knows right away that he is not his lover, Tankhun! Botpleng uses a mysterious murder case that happened on the day he met Tankhun as an excuse to get close to him and find out the truth. That makes Botpleng all the more impressed and swayed by this Tankhun. How will this love full of secrets unravel? What will become of Botpleng and Tankhun?
title: Melody of Secrets

overview: The peaceful life of Teacher Pobmek, a strict-looking primary school teacher who doesn't get along well with children, is about to be turned upside down when his cheerful boyfriend, Teacher Solar, gets into an accident that causes his mind to reset to that of a seven-year-old in an adult body every other day! Things get even more chaotic when Teacher Jee shows up as a new passionate and well-rounded primary school teacher, making his childhood friend Pobmek pale in comparison, so much so that Teacher Sodchuen, the acting principal, can't help but worry about the future of Teacher Pobmek's career and love life. Will this love end in complete disaster, or will it become the warmest lesson of a teacher's life?
title: Love You Teacher

overview: The MU-NIVERSE franchise features seven series, including "Hi" By My Luck, Not My Father, Diva Deva Mata starring Fluke Nattanon, Fist Foot Fusion, Hello' Is This Luck?, Love Me If You Swear, and Love Lock. Each story portrays a unique journey to finding love. Will the higher power help turn their luck around? Will their wishes be granted?
title: MU-TE-LUV

overview: Cat for Cash is a heartwarming story about cat lovers and a gang of cats unfolds when Tiger, a kind-hearted young creditor who adores cats, unexpectedly gains the special ability "to talk and hear cats" from Je Meow, a cat café owner, shortly before her death. The cats in the café then ask Tiger to help prevent Lynx, Je Meow's son, from selling the café. Matters become more complicated when Leo, Lynx's half-brother from the father's side, and Dr. Pomme, a charming veterinarian, enter the picture. Together, they become entangled in the effort to keep the cat café running while confronting unresolved family conflicts. How can the language of cats spark love among them?
title: Cat for Cash

overview: Juliet Bravo is a British television series, which ran on BBC1 between 1980 and 1985. The theme of the series concerned a female police inspector who took over control of a police station in the fictional town of Hartley in Lancashire. The series was devised by Ian Kennedy Martin, who had already enjoyed success with another police drama series, The Sweeney. The genre of police/crime dramas was well established on British television by 1980; however the BBC's Juliet Bravo, along with London Weekend Television's The Gentle Touch, which started a few months earlier, dealt with female officers as lead characters having to fight both crime and the prejudice of male colleagues. Ian Kennedy Martin actually based the character of Inspector Jean Darblay on a real life Female Police Inspector Wynne Darwin. She was in charge of the Police Station in Great Harwood just outside Manchester. The fictional Lancahire Town of Hartley was based on Great Harwood.
title: Juliet Bravo

overview: A friend group descends into chaos as their bonds are tested in a variety of ways, beginning with the return of an ex-girlfriend. Prim and Min are running an advertising company together when a new client Bambi, Prim's ex, shows up wanting to get back together. Adding to their circle is Prim's young stylist Gorya who's after a deeper connection, promiscuous and charming model Shasha, and Praew, the lesbian photographer from the bar bi-curious Min frequents.
title: Girl Rules

overview: Hop on the rollercoaster of love among 12th graders! Shane, a smart and driven student who excels in academics and school activities, has no interest in teenage life. That is, until he meets Kit, a carefree student who's his complete opposite. Forced to spend time together, sparks fly in unexpected ways. Meanwhile, Kim, another of Shane's classmates, is a hopeless romantic determined to find love before graduation. When he meets Mon, a new transfer student, Kim decides to do whatever it takes to win his heart. This new semester, open your heart to chaotic love experiences!
title: Boys in Love

overview: In, a gifted tarot reader, is asked by his best friend, Thordao, to give a false reading to her mom as a personal favor. At her house, he runs into Thapfah, an ICU doctor and Thordao's blunt older brother, who has no patience for fortune tellers. In blurts out a chilling prediction warning that a streak of misfortune is coming for Dr. Thapfah, so severe it could even cost him his life. Dr. Thapfah brushes it off at first. But as a series of unfortunate events hit, even his closest friend, Dr. Pokpong, and Police Inspector Ton suggest he lie low for a while. With few options left, Dr. Thapfah reluctantly agrees to retreat to Mae Hong Son with In.
title: My Magic Prophecy

overview: The strikingly handsome flight attendant Kanit lives inside the first-class life he has carefully built for himself. But that perfect world begins to fall apart the moment he meets Toto. Bold, carefree, mischievous, and sharp-tongued, Toto is the head of a rescue team—and the complete opposite of Kanit in every possible way. Yet fate keeps throwing them together. What begins with a simple luggage mix-up soon pulls them into each other's lives in ways neither of them can escape. Then comes the real mission: Kanit suspects his handsome pilot boyfriend, Lion, of cheating. Determined to uncover the truth, he drags Toto into an undercover plan to catch the third party in the act. But as the two bickering men chase clues, trade insults, and stumble through one chaotic situation after another, they slowly begin to see the softest parts of each other's hearts.
title: A Dog and a Plane

overview: Thee Theerakit Kian Lee, the eldest son of an ex-mafia, left his past in arms trafficking behind to launch a perfume and accessories brand called Arseni. Chaos erupts when Mr. Thee has his eyes on Aran, a model close to Peach Peachayarat, a famous freelance photographer shooting the brand's new perfume collection. Peach loves his quiet, introverted life—but it's turned upside down forever when he's roped into becoming Mr. Thee's love coach, only to be pursued by him instead in over-the-top ways, as if trying to set a new world record in wooing.
title: Me and Thee

overview: Pete, a luckless man with a shard of demon spirit hidden inside him, can sense the presence of Yao, a strange devouring evil force that controls the mind of men. He meets Nirund who introduces him to the world of Wu. The two fall into a necessary partnership and must team up with others to suppress Yao and defeat the evil of the world. Will Nirund, Pete, and their team be able to get through this challenge, and how exactly are their souls intertwined?
title: WU

overview: From the pages of the memoir of Rati, an orphan born of a commoner who has been adopted by an aristocrat, who returns to Siam for the first time in 20 years as an interpreter for the French ambassador. There, he meets Theeratorn, a marquis in the Ministry of Education. Their love at first sight turns into companionship, which then turns into love. But this love blooms among various constraints and conflicts of its time. Just like the taboo of social differences between Mek, a lowly commoner, and Baronnet Dech which threatens their budding friendship. Does true love pull through everything?
title: Memoir of Rati

overview: Tanrak is a devout young man determined to pursue the priesthood in hopes of reuniting with his parents in heaven. His heart is put to the test when he meets Barth, a new friend with deep emotional wounds. Amidst the ironclad rules of the school and the watchful eyes of Father Arnon, a bond that transcends friendship begins to bloom. When faith clashes with forbidden feelings, Tanrak must choose between the path to God and the path of love. Where exactly does their true heaven lie?
title: Ticket to Heaven

overview: Broadcast from the future, Discontinued is a show about the past... a past before the world domination of A.I.. With introspection and humor, we look at products, experiences- and everything in between- that remind us of humankind's memorable past.
title: Discontinued

overview: Ranchland Listings is a series that follows the thrilling world of multi-million dollar ranch properties across the USA and Canada. Spotlighting passionate owners, elite real estate agents, and wealthy buyers as they navigate the rugged, luxurious landscape of these sprawling estates. Each episode reveals the unique challenges, and jaw-dropping beauty of expansive properties. From mountainous retreats to plains-side hideaways, viewers get an inside look at the fascinating, high-stakes process of buying and selling dream ranches, where deals hinge on vision, charisma and expertise in this niche but lucrative market.
title: Ranchland Listings

overview: Single father George Altman is doing his best to raise his sixteen-year-old daughter Tessa in the big city. When he discovers a box of condoms in her bedroom, though, he decides the time has come to move her to a more wholesome and nurturing environment: the suburbs. But behind the beautiful homes and perfect lawns lurk the Franken-moms, spray tans, nose jobs, and Red Bull-guzzling teens who have nothing in common with Tessa. It's a whole new world, one that makes George wonder if they haven't jumped out of the frying pan and into the fire.
title: Suburgatory

overview: Z Cars or Z-Cars was a British television drama series centred on the work of mobile uniformed police in the fictional town of Newtown, based on Kirkby, Merseyside. Produced by the BBC, it debuted in January 1962 and ran until September 1978. The series differed sharply from earlier police procedurals. With its less-usual Northern setting, it injected a new element of harsh realism into the image of the police, which some found unwelcome. Z Cars ran for a total of 803 episodes, of which fewer than half have survived. Regular stars included Stratford Johns (Detective Inspector Barlow), Frank Windsor (Det. Sgt Watt), James Ellis (Bert Lynch) and Brian Blessed ("Fancy" Smith). Barlow and Watt were later spun into a separate series "Softly, Softly". The name Z Cars relates to an imaginary "Z" Division of the local constabulary. The theme tune was based on a traditional Liverpool folk song, and was adopted by Everton Football Club as its official anthem.
title: Z Cars

overview: Giulio Zagni is The Perfect Boss, the beloved and undisputed king of his steering wheel factory and his family. Friends, relatives, and employees may veer off course, but Giulio is always there to set things right, no matter the cost. However, when this well-oiled machine suddenly falters, the professional and personal life of this exemplary entrepreneur in Italy's Motor Valley spirals out of control. Amid tragicomic twists and strokes of genius, will Giulio manage to get back on track?
title: Il Capo Perfetto

overview: TG4 is delighted to present Vóta 2024, a comprehensive two-day live event covering the results and detailed analysis of this year's general election. Hosted by Siún Nic Gearailt and Eimear Ní Chonaola, these special broadcasts will bring viewers expert insights, live result updates, and in-depth commentary as the nation charts its political future.
title: Vóta 2024

overview: Virgin Media News brings you all the latest updates as votes are counted in General Election 2024.
title: Virgin Media News Special

overview: Welcome to Ed Finn's America, where I'm taking you on an unforgettable journey across some of the most vibrant and historic cities in the US.
title: Ed Finn's America

overview: Told through the lens of two men whose lives are far more connected than they realize, Silent River explores the cracks of small-town America in the wake of discovering a serial killer among them.
title: Silent River

overview: The story begins with six men trapped inside an unfamiliar, abandoned warehouse, each with a mysterious collar around their necks. They have no idea how they got there or what's happening, but their confusion quickly turns to shock when a plushie dog begins to speak.
title: Tokimeki Bakudan

overview: Jérôme Kerviel -- the trader who hid €50 billion in trades at a major international bank -- and his former superiors reveal all sides of the scandal.
title: Kerviel : Un Trader, 50 Milliards

overview: Harlan Coben's I Will Find You follows an innocent father serving life in prison for murdering his own son, who receives evidence that his child may actually still be alive — and must break out of prison to find the truth.
title: Harlan Coben's I Will Find You

overview: The series provides unprecedented access to Pulisic's life and growing celebrity in Italy as he competes in UEFA Champions League and Serie A competitions. Cameras capture Pulisic's journey in meeting the demands of global stardom while he prepares for the biggest moment of his career - the 2026 FIFA Men's World Cup on home soil.
title: Pulisic

overview: The unique and fascinating history of Russia was not created only by men. Among those who led and directed the chronology of events, there are many great women who certainly cannot be called the "weaker sex". The authors tell about scientists and writers, designers and engineers, artists and politicians who converted and changed the country for the better.
title: Женщина в истории

overview: Two years ago, Just abandoned his law studies and severed ties with Rule to uncover the truth behind his parents' murder. Two years later, Rule, now a lawyer, still haunted by Just's disappearance, finally tracks him down to a seedy Gogo Bar, only to find him embroiled in a deadly feud with the Kung gang. But Just isn't alone. The bar is a haven for those consumed by vengeance:Salt, the security guard who always with bloody smell, the runaway teen Tiger, and Ice, the ruthless madam running sexual business for the gang. Each carries the scent of violence, a simmering powder keg waiting to explode. Are you ready to descend into their dark, bloody, and tear-soaked path to retribution?
title: Eyes on You

overview: Facing danger, risking persecution. Witnesses and survivors reveal the truth about anti-government protests in Iran, from 2009's contested election to the fight for women's rights.
title: Rage Against the Regime: Iran

overview: Series following some of the Gaeilgeoirí building careers and homes in Brussels, the multilingual capital of Europe.
title: La Vie sa Bhruiséil

overview: Joanne Cantwell, Darragh Maloney and Jacqui Hurley present the RTÉ Sport Awards 2024.
title: RTÉ Sport Awards

overview: A look at the shortlist and winner of the An Post Irish Book of the Year 2024.
title: An Post Irish Book of the Year

overview: Teens at the Alpha Ranch wildlife preserve join forces with trained animals to rescue people in danger. The Alpha Team, comprised of humans and animals, acts as a search and rescue unit. Led by Bob Donell and his children, Kathy and Jim, they respond whenever someone is lost, injured, or stranded. Each episode highlights the unique abilities of specific animals for their rescue missions. Featured wildlife includes a raccoon, lion, black bear, otter, hawk, cougar, chimpanzee, donkey, St. Bernard, and jaguar. Based in the Midwest, the Donell family is ready for on-call missions around the world, from remote rural areas to city streets.
title: Search and Rescue: The Alpha Team

overview: Raised during the apocalypse in an underground home, a young man and his siblings must venture into a nuclear-active world filled with monsters.
title: Silo

overview: Propelled by a mystery that disrupts a seemingly harmonious beachside community, the series explores the universal challenges of motherhood, marriage, friendship, and the complexities of identity. It's peak holiday season in the popular seaside town of Osprey Point when an enigmatic stranger, Isabelle rents a family home in a quiet cul-de-sac. As Isabelle charms her way into her neighbours' homes and lives, she quickly discovers that everyone at Pleasant Court has something to hide. How far will her obsessive drive to solve a mystery push her to expose the truth?
title: The Family Next Door
